definitions.ask: Should every note older than the fresh window ask before Ctrl+Shift+D deletes it?
definitions.why: Asking is the safe default; every recent legitimate delete hit a note under a day old

choices.label: Every older Markdown note asks, except a blank note that nothing links to
Only linked, task-holding, or area/project/notebook older notes ask

definitions.ask: Should any delete within 5 seconds of the previous one ask, even for a fresh note?
definitions.why: The incident was a second press landing on whatever file Obsidian focused next

choices.label: A fast second press always asks, catching the double press that took dev.md
Only the file's own signals decide; a double press on two fresh notes deletes both

definitions.ask: Should a note count as fresh (deletable without asking) for 24 hours after its created stamp?
definitions.why: Bryan's test notes and accidental future daily notes are deleted the same day

choices.label: Fresh for 24 hours, covering every legitimate delete in the vault history
Fresh for 1 hour only, so yesterday's scratch and test notes ask too
